note: SMG ADS comparison candidate smg_ads_front_sight_gap3.png skin regions (development trial, not adopted). Same decided range as the hip: weapon_body = housing seen from behind (the stepped sight base / top of the receiver under the sights, the round cocking knob on the left of the sight base, the rear end block and its rear face); fixed colour = rear and front sight posts, the wire stock arms (left rail, right diagonal bar), sling loop, line black. Hands = glove, wrist band, sleeve base / camo. Areas read from the image (gridded crops, 2026-10-22). Read by Tools/pixelart/make_image_regions.py.

steel.why: dark grey steel housing (lightness median 0.24); the tan slot frame and the gloves are more saturated

sight_base.why: stepped sight base / receiver top under the sight posts (the posts above y 470 stay fixed)

cocking_knob.why: round knob on the left of the sight base (the bolt / knob is recoloured)

rear_block.why: rear end block of the housing and its rear face; the wire stock arms left (x < 830) and right (diagonal bar, mostly x > 995) stay fixed

arms.why: both hands and sleeves (glove / sleeve colours do not occur on the gun)
